learnings: Best risk-adjusted sleeves that worked in both 2008-2018 and 2019+: Dairy trend basket: 20-day breakouts in milk, cheese, butter, powder, whey (Sharpe 1.62, 2019+ 1.29, max DD -15.5%, Calmar 1.12); Blend: equal risk of the 11 sleeves with Sharpe > 0.3 in 2008-2018 (Sharpe 0.93, 2019+ 1.0, max DD -20.8%, Calmar 0.48); Trend, every market long if up / short if down over 4-week (Sharpe 0.88, 2019+ 1.39, max DD -17.6%, Calmar 0.51); Strong uptrends long (price > 50 > 200-day), downtrends short (Sharpe 0.82, 2019+ 1.0, max DD -28.4%, Calmar 0.28); Trend blend: average of 1, 3, 6 and 12-month signals (Sharpe 0.76, 2019+ 1.08, max DD -25.7%, Calmar 0.28).

Lowest drawdown per unit of return (Calmar), both periods positive: Dairy trend basket: 20-day breakouts in milk, cheese, butter, powder, whey (Calmar 1.12, max DD -15.5%, hit 59.3%); Trend, every market long if up / short if down over 4-week (Calmar 0.51, max DD -17.6%, hit 53.5%); Blend: equal risk of the 11 sleeves with Sharpe > 0.3 in 2008-2018 (Calmar 0.48, max DD -20.8%, hit 57.1%); Long backwardated uptrends, short contangoed downtrends (Calmar 0.31, max DD -23.6%, hit 54.8%); Strong uptrends long (price > 50 > 200-day), downtrends short (Calmar 0.28, max DD -28.4%, hit 54.6%).

Did not work: Short-term reversal: long last week's losers, short winners (Sharpe -0.77); Follow 4-week spec flow (cross-section) (Sharpe -0.38); Liquidity provision: short last week's biggest spec buying, long the biggest selling (Sharpe -0.35); Skewness: long most negatively skewed, short most positively skewed (52 weeks) (Sharpe -0.27).
Blend of the sleeves picked on 2008-2018 only: Sharpe 1.0 in 2019+ (vs 0.88 in-sample), max DD -20.8%, worst week -6.31% at 10% vol.
